title: Brain Organizer
shortDescription: A personal full-stack organizer for tracking daily logs, todos, and progress across 30+ projects — built because Notion was overkill.
description: A self-hosted PWA built with Next.js and Supabase for tracking daily logs, per-project todos, and progress timelines. Features real-time sync across iOS and desktop, priority color coding, customizable push notification reminders, and a global dashboard summarizing all active projects.
highlights: Real-time sync across iOS and desktop via Supabase Realtime
Per-project daily logs with timeline view
Push notifications for todos and customizable reminders
Global dashboard with priority color coding across 30+ projects
reason: I was drowning in todo2.txt files and papers all over my desk. Notion was too generic and fought my workflow. So I specced and built exactly what my brain needed — per-project daily logs, priority-colored todos, and reminders — in an afternoon using Cursor.
